name: untitled boss game
desc:
Welcome to Untitled Boss Game.. 

Gear up with other players to take on different Retro Bosses.. Use your cash, defeats, and rebirths to purchase new weapons, armor, and gears to help you defeat other bosses. Work with your server to defeat specific bosses to earn greater rewards!

[HOW TO PLAY]
⚔️Fight & Defeat a Boss!⚔️
💵Use your rewards to purchase better weapons!💵
💎Rebirth💎
🔥Continue gearing up and defeating cooler bosses!🔥
